idea.why: Track the shifting trade agreements between India, China, and Canada to predict which commodity imports (like canola oil or lithium) will face sudden duty increases. While new deals like the $400M Canada-China pact are expanding, specific items still face massive tariffs (e.g., 165% on Scotch), creating unpredictable supply shocks for retailers dependent on these regions.
